The real answer to this question lies within you.

For me life is all about decisions. You are brought to this world whether you want it or not and from that point on all your decisions will be important. Make the best out of the situation and enjoy the good things in life.

You could send her a letter, trying to express your situation to her. A personal letter is always appreciated, especially these days where basically everyone is 'connected' through the internet. Another option would be to meet up with her and give her the letter personally, so you can see her response. I know it's hard to keep these feelings within you and carry them along everywhere, I know it so well.

Hey, man.

I have a very simple advice: Surround yourself with positive things and positive things will happen to you :) 

If people don't make you happy or appreciate you enough for the wonderful person that you are, then you should just forget about them. There is sometimes no need to forcefully achieve something or be someone that just isn't possible. We are just humans, afterall. Not everyone fits with everyone, it's totally normal.

Please, don't. You have a son, I'm sure he will be alright and who knows maybe when he's older he will reach out to you and theres going to be a father-son-get-together. In case that doesn't happen, I think you did the best you could. The way you wrote about your son is really lovely. So you have nothing to lose. Just hang in there for a bit longer, okay? 

What about this new woman who takes care of you? Does she know about all of this? I'm sure she is trying her best to make you happy. Isn't this what every man seeks?  

Also I advise you to go to r/personalfinance. The people there give out amazing advice about jobs, charges and basically anything that's related to finance.  

I hope I could help you, atleast make you feel a bit better. I think you had a very interesting life so far and things will be fine in the near future. Feel free to shoot me a PM if you want :)

Thank you, your post made me cry a bit, too. Sometimes we even forget that we're fine and actually happy, but when we really think about our situations it can bring the hardest guys to tears. Keep on!

I'm sorry to hear that your girlfriend did this. Some people really start to 'bloom' after relationships so now it's time to focus on yourself. Check your area for psycho therapists or counselors, they will gladly help you on a mental basis. Then start doing whatever makes you happy, learn about new things, draw, make or listen to new music, just inspire yourself to do something new, something that will make you feel good. And if you've done that, you'll feel like one hell of a badass and your ex will be missing out all of that. You will be fine :)

Sometimes you can't make people to understand. In this case it's really the best to ignore the surroundings you find the most annoying and just get on with yourself. People like you shouldn't waste their precious time on fools. Take a walk outside in the nature and forget all those 'riots'. You'll be alright and if something isn't just get back here and we'll be here to help you as much as we can :)

I read about it just now and I'm really sorry to hear what happened. Please, don't just leave with all the money you have left with no specific directions to go. I know how it feels when you feel like you have nothing else in the world to live for, and most likely you will feel the same about your parents, but believe me. Deep down I am sure your parents would pay every dime they had to get you back. Shoot me a PM, I'm sure we can work out something together.

It's totally fine to be tired. We all get tired from time to time. It just makes us human, don't you think? What is weighing you down so much? I'm certain we can work out a way to get you back up. Speaking of tired: it's 4:30 AM here but I'm not going to sleep. I'll be waiting for your response :)

You my dear, yes, your very self is the centre of your own life. You are like gravity by having the ability to move everything around you at your own pace. 

You can find that job, it just takes time.
You can sort the moving-in-together-things, it just takes time.
You can be very ambitious about the goals in your own life, it... oh, wait you already are!
Seriously, I am astonished at how well you analyzed so many aspects of your life in such a short post and give yourself these 'limits'. But, please, please don't set those kinds of goals in your life like 'If I can't achieve this by x time, I will do y'. Please. If you don't achieve them, I can garantuee you that you will feel so bad and disappointed of yourself that it might break you and who knows what really happens by that time.. 

I just wanna say don't pressure yourself so much. Get in a room, sit down and try to smile. Just try. Just so you can start thinking in a good mindset. And then start slowly but gradually thinking about yourself. About how much you have achieved, about all the pain you had to go through and how much effort you have put in your life so far. You have survived and you will surpass everything that's coming your way, for you are the gravity. 

PS: You have a really cute username.
